card.name: Overestimating dose in opioid warnings
card.fires_on: The word piece "imating" in "Overestimating" at the start of the opioid warning about converting doses. It also fires weakly on dose-related words like delay, dose and reduced in dosing instructions.

modes.label: Overestimating warning
modes.description: The "imating" ending of "Overestimating" in the opioid conversion warning after "titration ... are essential".
modes.example: proper dosing and titration of APADAZ are essential [see Dosage and Administration ( 2 )] . Overest<<imating>> the APADAZ dosage when converting patients

modes.label: Dose adjustment words
modes.description: Dose-related words in instructions about delaying, reducing or converting doses.
